description: This file defines the SugarOAuth class, which extends Zend_Oauth_Consumer to implement OAuth client functionality for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including token management, request handling, and debugging features.

classes.name: SugarOAuth
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_Oauth_Consumer to provide OAuth handling capabilities tailored for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including token creation, HTTP request execution with OAuth and proxy support, and debugging features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth consumer with provided key, secret, and optional parameters, merging configuration.

methods.name: enableDebug
methods.description: Enables debugging (stub method returning the current object).

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the OAuth token and secret for subsequent requests.

methods.name: makeRequestToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a Zend_Oauth_Token_Request object for the current token.

methods.name: makeAccessToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a Zend_Oauth_Token_Access object for the current token.

methods.name: getRequestTokenByUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a request token from a provided URL, parsing query parameters if present.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token from a URL, using the current request token.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs an authenticated HTTP request to a specified URL, supporting GET or other methods and proxy configuration.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns an HTTP client configured with OAuth access token.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP response body received from a request.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP request sent.
